verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-device execution where prompts, audio and images stay on the phone, and it shows hosted execution is an explicit choice. These are privacy-by-locality properties, not user controls over retention or deletion. The only retention-related detail is that the Wally console playground "keeps your recent conversations," and no setting to limit, export or delete that data is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
